findings.quote: Yes. As of 2026-11-10, secret scanning is switched on for harborlight/docs.
findings.explanation: The question asks about the application repository, which LIB-SS-APP identifies as harborlight/app and says does not yet have secret scanning on, while the draft answers yes based on harborlight/docs.
The draft reports on harborlight/docs, a different repository, and never says whether secret scanning is on for the application repository (harborlight/app).
